title: Nice litte steamer with flaws
text: Nice litte steamer with flaws. I was excited when I saw this in the Vine newsletter. I was traveling to Florida last weekend and wanted a travel steamer to take with me for the trip. For pros, this is complact and attractive and does create steam (although not consistently. I am rating this as three stars because it had a propensity to leak (thank goodness I wasn't using this on silk). I was disappointed to say the least and although it did the trick on the few pants and shirts I had, I had them spotted with water (but fortunately did not stain anything when it dried).

product_metadata.title: Rowenta IS1430 Pro Compact Garment and Fabric Steamer with Accessories, 1400-Watt, Gray
features: Compact 1400-watt steamer with wide steam head heats up in 2 minutes
33-ounce water tank can be refilled during use for continuous steam
Fabric hose with 360-degree swivel base for steam from any angle
Upholstery brush, lint pad, fabric brush, crease attachment, and door hook included
Measures approximately 15 by 10-1/2 by 9-1/2 inches; 1-year limited warranty
description: "It's all about the Steam". New from Rowenta the IS1430 Pro Compact Steamer is designed for increased ease of use. Taking only 2 1/2 minutes to heat up, you can continuously and easily refill the large 32 oz reservoir for maximum steam output, creating fabulous results. Powerful 1400 watts, the steam hose connector has a 360 degree swivel base; a wide steam head for great distribution and a cool touch fabric hose that wraps around the base for easy storage. The IS1430 Pro Compact Stemaer comes with: an Upholstery Brush used to aid steam penetration into difficult, heavy fabrics; a Lint Pad used to remove hair, lint and animal fur for a professional finish; a Fabric Brush used to open weaves of the fabrics for better steam penetration; a Crease Attachment to help make sharp creases easily and helps removes stubborn wrinkles and a convenient Door Hook for use on any door to hang clothes while vertically steaming.
